study: Original compression-level browser trial: two partial failures and full zero-delta control
scope: All original raw/canonical/comparison/policy receipts, partial warmup failures, full VNDB timing/control/memory records and exact audit sources. No repaired harness or future acquisition included. No import speedup established.
memberPathBase: Original workspace-relative path; contents are byte-for-byte unchanged
archiveMetadata: gzip timestamp, tar ownership and file timestamps normalized; payload paths and contents preserved
symlinkPolicy: All payload files and their directory components must be regular, non-symlink paths; symlink targets are never read
manifestPlacement: External to archive so every archive member, without a self-hash exception, has a digest
